name: @hasna/actions
description: Typed, auditable action contracts for agentic software.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external @hasna/contracts --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --external @hasna/contracts --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk && bun build src/index.ts src/storage.ts src/types.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @hasna/contracts && bun build src/sdk/index.ts --outdir dist/sdk --target bun --external @hasna/contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.verify:release: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run repo:conformance
scripts.prepack: bun run verify:release && bun run scan:artifact
